question: What result follows from making fire offerings with bilva flowers?
premises: Fire offerings are made with bilva flowers.
Ramā refers to the goddess Lakṣmī.
Becoming her abode is stated as the outcome.
inference: One who offers bilva flowers into the fire becomes an abode of Ramā.
plain_english: By offering bilva flowers into the fire, one becomes an abode of Ramā.
